title: Topological Threshold Index Delta b_2 = 28 and Forward Gauge Coupling Prediction

scope.frame: Unconditioned forward evaluation of Standard Model gauge couplings from M_GUT to M_Z with modular DKL threshold and topological integer index
scope.object: forward prediction of electroweak gauge couplings from topological threshold Delta b_2 = 28 (dim SO(8)) at tau_*, yielding sin^2 theta_W = 0.23144 (0.097% relative error) and alpha_EM^-1 = 127.987 (0.029% relative error) without back-solving experimental gaps (P-398)
scope.hypotheses: Modular apex tau_*; DKL threshold formula; topological index Delta b_2 = 28; 2HDM 1-loop RGE flow

claim_one_line: TOPOLOGICAL THRESHOLD INDEX DELTA B2 = 28 AND FORWARD GAUGE COUPLINGS (P-398): derived the topological threshold index Delta b_2 = 28 (matching dim SO(8) in the E8 adjoint index on Y/Q_8) and evaluated the forward DKL modular correction Delta alpha_2^-1 = 3.095591, yielding forward predictions sin^2 theta_W(M_Z) = 0.231444 (PDG 0.23122, 0.097% rel error) and alpha_EM^-1(M_Z) = 127.987 (PDG 127.95, 0.029% rel error) at alpha_s(M_Z) = 0.1180, replacing the round-trip gap diagnostic with an unconditioned forward derivation.
weave_or_thread: weave (topological threshold index and forward gauge coupling prediction)
